criteria.criterion: Admission gates, independent identities, commit-bound reports, and Spec approval invalidation
criteria.method: Ran factory unit suite in disposable clone; inspected role and record contracts.
criteria.evidence: `python3 -m unittest discover -s factory/tests -v`: all 6 tests passed, including illegal transition/Spec skip, exact Spec hash approval invalidation, self-review rejection, stale review commit rejection, and requiring a new review for attempt 2.

criteria.criterion: Failed verification returns through a fresh Implement report and Review before another Verify
criteria.method: Drove an end-to-end synthetic lifecycle through the real CLI in disposable clone: Triage, Spec skip, Implement attempt 1, ACCEPT Review, FAIL Verify, then BUILDING.
criteria.evidence: After `advance VERIFY-LOOP BUILDING`, `advance VERIFY-LOOP REVIEWING` succeeded with no new Implement report. A new Review dispatch was accepted, but its report failed with `attempt already has this role report; create a new implementation attempt`. This leaves the item in REVIEWING with the old candidate and prevents a valid retry. CLI transcript: `/tmp/dial-verify-records/cli-evidence.log`; snapshot: `/tmp/dial-verify-records/final-state.json`.

criteria.criterion: State recovery, malformed report handling, and metrics remain consistent
criteria.method: Ran existing test suite and inspected synthetic CLI run metadata.
criteria.evidence: Unit suite passed recovery after corrupting the event mirror, rejecting incomplete verification evidence, and deriving first-review/verification and loop metrics. CLI run records captured requested model/reasoning and explicit null reported model/tokens/cost with a harness-unavailable reason.

criteria.criterion: Blocked/failed handoff preserves truthful result and generates journal/public notes
criteria.method: Ran existing synthetic blocked and terminal-failure handoff tests.
criteria.evidence: Unit suite passed `test_blocked_handoff_and_artifacts` and `test_terminal_failure_needs_reason`; checks confirm BLOCKED remains final_result and both journal and PUBLIC_NOTES artifacts are generated.

criteria.criterion: Latest-attempt gating prevents older PASS evidence from overriding a later failed rerun
criteria.method: Reviewed the candidate's current-attempt selectors and exercised a failed verification attempt through CLI.
criteria.evidence: The executed CLI case had no earlier PASS report to compare. Candidate code selects Review/Verify reports matching the latest Implement attempt, but this specific PASS-then-later-FAIL sequence was not run.
